title: Lifting the Veil: The Benefits of Cost Transparency
authors: Bhavya Mohan; Ryan W. Buell; Leslie K. John
eligible_reason: No staggered DiD. Lab/online experiments (Studies 1B-5, SPSS) and a field experiment (Study 1A, logit of soup purchase on cost-transparency sign alternated within days). The 'anecdotal evidence' analysis is a single-firm time-series regression of treated-product sales share on a post dummy with traffic and lagged controls; its data are withheld under NDA.
design_notes: anecdotal_evidence_code.do: reg pct_sales_treat post2 [total_visits ... lag_novisit_pct ... lag_nosale_pct] if color=="Black". Study 1A CNS_analysis_code.do: logit chickenoodle i.transparency i.dayofweekn i.time, cluster(date).
data_files_note: Experimental data shipped; anecdotal-evidence sales data withheld (README: signed NDA).
data_provenance_note: Experimental data are original; the only pre/post analysis has no shipped data.
software_notes: Stata (Study 1A, anecdotal evidence) and SPSS (Studies 1B-5, web appendix).
